university-of-southern-california.label: USC Undergraduate Admission
evidence: Early Action (EA) is non-binding and non-restrictive.
Students who are sure that USC is their first choice, and are prepared to make a commitment to attend, can apply Early Decision (ED) to USC.
Students applying to majors in the performing arts must apply Regular Decision by the December 1 deadline.
Final first-year deadline for majors that do not have a December 1 deadline.

plans.note: Performing-arts majors have a single December 1 Regular Decision deadline instead; January 10 is the final deadline for all other majors.

university-of-southern-california.note: USC runs ED and EA on the same November 1 date. The page states the cycle explicitly ("November 1, 2026"), confirming fall 2027 entry.

dartmouth-college.label: Dartmouth Admissions
evidence: Early Decision (ED) is an early admission round in which students submit their application by November 1 and receive an admission decision by mid-December.

Regular Decision (RD) is an admission round in which students submit their application by January 1 and receive an admission decision by late March or early April, and, if admitted, have until May 1 to either accept or decline their offer.
dartmouth-college.note: manual: the site refuses automated requests and the dates sit inside collapsed accordions, so this was read in a browser. Dartmouth offers no Early Action round.

california-institute-of-technology.label: Caltech Undergraduate Admissions
evidence: Caltech offers two decision plans: Restrictive Early Action and Regular Decision.
Although REA applications are due November 1, you will have until November 6 to submit all required and supplemental materials and standardized testing must be completed before November 30.
Although RD applications are due January 4, you will have until January 10 to submit all required and supplemental materials and standardized testing must be completed before December 31, 2026.

plans.note: Restrictive: an REA applicant may not apply EA or ED elsewhere, with stated exceptions including any public institution with a non-binding fall deadline.

california-institute-of-technology.note: manual: JS-rendered page. Caltech has no Early Decision round. The RD paragraph says admitted students have "until May 1, 2026" to decide, which is a typo on Caltech's page for the fall 2027 cycle (the REA paragraph says May 1, 2027) — it does not affect either application deadline.

pomona-college.label: Pomona College Admissions
evidence: Early Decision I Nov. 8 By Dec. 15 Jan. 1
Early Decision II Jan. 8 By Feb. 15 March 1
Regular Decision Jan. 8 By April 1 May 1
pomona-college.note: Early Decision II and Regular Decision share the January 8 deadline; they differ in that ED II is binding. Pomona offers no Early Action round.

scripps-college.label: Scripps College Admission
scripps-college.note: Early Decision II and Regular Decision share the January 14 deadline; ED II binds. No Early Action round.
